detail.longDescription:
PythonX is a complete Python learning app for beginners and working developers. It combines structured Python tutorials, an offline compiler, guided coding projects and a verifiable certificate in a single application.

More than 5 million learners have used this Python coding app to progress from first principles to working code. No desktop setup and no prior programming experience are required.

A Python coding app with an offline compiler

A built-in code editor and offline compiler run Python 3 programs directly on your device, with or without an internet connection. Write code, execute it, review the output and correct errors in place. Because the compiler works offline, coding practice remains available wherever connectivity is limited.

Structured Python tutorials, basics to advanced

The syllabus is organised into 20+ courses that progress in a defined order, so the next topic is always clear:
• Python basics: variables, data types, input and output
• Operators, numbers, strings and string formatting
• Conditional statements and decision making
• Loops, lists, tuples, dictionaries and sets
• Functions, modules and file handling
• Exception handling and debugging
• Object-oriented programming and classes
• Multithreading and database connectivity
• GUI development
• Interview questions and answers

Learn Python coding through applied practice

Every tutorial closes with a quiz, and 500+ ready-to-run code examples can be edited and executed in place. Three guided coding projects consolidate the material into complete, working programs:
• Project 1 - Supermarket Cashier
• Project 2 - Library Management App
• Project 3 - Employee CRUD App

Progress is tracked across the syllabus, and lessons support audio playback for study away from the screen.

AI tutor and AI courses

An integrated AI tutor reviews your code, explains it line by line and identifies errors, providing assistance at the point where progress stalls. Dedicated courses cover artificial intelligence, generative AI and large language models for learners extending beyond core programming.

Certification
Completing the syllabus issues a verifiable certificate that can be shared on a professional profile or included with a job application.

Prepare for examinations, placements and interviews

Python programming underpins web development, automation, software testing, scripting and analytics, and remains the standard first language for data science and machine learning. This Python learning app covers the interview questions most frequently asked by recruiters, alongside practice sets for university examinations and campus placements. Lessons are short enough to complete in a single sitting.

Intended for

• Beginners who want to learn to code in Python for the first time
• Students preparing for examinations, placements or a computer science degree
• Professionals moving into a programming or software development career
• Experienced developers who need a syntax reference and a compiler on mobile
• Anyone who wants to learn Python coding without access to a desktop machine

Why learn Python programming

Python syntax is close to plain English, which makes it the most accessible entry point into programming and the reason it is taught first at most universities. Competence in Python programming supports backend development, automation, scripting, testing and the foundations required for data science.

Support

The syllabus is reviewed and extended each month. 
For bug reports, feature requests or content suggestions, contact hello@codingx.app. Ratings and reviews on Google Play help other learners find this Python tutorial app.
